_comment: Every number that decides a search-quality gate. It holds no question. It is locked at the merge of the harness pull request (P0a), before any held-out number exists. A change after the lock is a new commit that says why, and numbers from before and after a change are never mixed in one claim. The thresholds come from scripts/alice_bench_gates.py, which prints each gate's pass rate for an assumed flip rate, so a reviewer can rerun them.

lock.point: the merge of the harness pull request (P0a)
lock.note: The baseline run compares a checkout with itself, so it cannot move a threshold. The verdict script prints the sha256 of this file it applied.

tier1.hit_rule_note: A question is a Tier 1 hit when every one of its required facts has an anchor in a scored string that ends inside the first gate_budget_bytes of the serialized output. A question flips when its hit changes between two states.

G1.compares: Tier 1 at gate_budget_bytes, ALICE_SEARCH_QUALITY=passage against off, same commit, both variants

keyword.fails_when: regressions exceed improvements with a one-sided exact sign test p below p_max

G2.compares: Tier 1 at gate_budget_bytes, on against passage, same commit, both variants

verbatim.fails_when: regressions exceed improvements with a one-sided exact sign test p below p_max

G3.compares: lexical against lexical plus vectors, the recorded local model, after a spike go

G4.compares: Tier 2, the candidate at its flip values against v0.20.0, same session, same questions
G4.fails_when: the mean correct fraction (candidate minus v0.20.0) plus z standard errors of the paired per-question difference is below zero

gate_rules.net: improved minus regressed, over the pooled questions
gate_rules.sign_test: one-sided and exact, on the discordant pairs
gate_rules.failed_gate: keeps its switch off; a G4 failure keeps every switch off

passage_cap_rule.pick: the cap with the highest hit count at budget_bytes, taking each cap's lowest count across the import orders

ci_time.job: python-unit (Unit tests + live eval battery, SQLite)
ci_time.measured_scope: successful push runs of tests.yml on main, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02

p0a_tests.note: The tests of the harness pull request, run alone on a laptop. The CI cost is read from the python-unit job of that pull request against the measured range above.

ci_time.rule: The tests of the search-quality release add at most new_test_budget_seconds to this job. The on-mode job is a separate job and runs in parallel. If the job passes split_threshold_minutes, the first pull request to cross the line splits the unit tests by directory before another test lands.

hashes._comment: Left empty on purpose. The tower fills each field before the first held-out run: the sha256 of the tower's own stdlib scorer, of each prompt text, and of each held-out question set. Builders never see the questions or the prompt texts, only these hashes.
